_comment: Single source of truth for presets. stream_client.py (--preset), run_matrix.py (--profile) and live.html (preset dropdown, served by live_server.py at /presets.json) all read this file. "cli": true means stream_client.py can send every param in the preset. "matrix": true means run_matrix.py includes it in --profile all. Values are streaming query params.

voice_agent_open.note: Open-ended user turns (support or sales agent). Longer EOU tolerance.

voice_agent_short_reply.note: Yes, no and digit confirmations. Tight EOU, ITN off, boosted keywords.

ivr.note: Phone menus. Tight EOU, ITN off, digits and star/pound boosted. Uses whatever sample rate and encoding your audio has.

dictation.note: Long-form monologue. Loose EOU, ITN on.

meeting_diarize.note: Word and sentence timestamps plus speaker diarization for meetings.

pci_redacted_agent.note: Voice-agent flow with PII and PCI redaction (en and hi only).

keywords_demo.note: Bias one proper-noun spelling. Edit keywords freely.

raw_no_formatting.note: format=false gives lowercase text with no punctuation and no ITN.
